newsitem.title: CANADA: Arakis completes rainy season Sudan wells.
newsitem.headline: Arakis completes rainy season Sudan wells.

text.p: Arakis Energy Corp said on Monday that its consortium completed the first four of a 13 well rniny season drilling program on its oil concession in southern Sudan.
Arakis said the group was increasing its activity and had four active drilling rigs in the country which were expected to drill 20 wells this year, up from nine in 1996.
The four wells included El Full 86c on the Heglig Block and three on the Unity Block.

The company, whose partners include China National Petroleum Corp, Malaysia state oil firm Petronas and the Sudan government, said the El Full well was drilled to a depth of 1,956 metres reaching the Bentiu III formation.
It said 25 metres of net pay over a gross interval of 60 meters was identified in the Bentiu I zone and testing was to begin shortly.
This structure directly offset the Toma field which was tied in to the Early Production System developed in 1995, Arakis said.
The three Unity were drilled targeting new reserves contained in separate fault closures offsetting the main field, it said.
Arakis said rigs were moved to three new wet season locations, including an exploration location at El Har, just north of the Unity field. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
